description: Bank-styled page tells customers who were just phoned to install a remote-access app, read the session ID and password to the caller, and open mobile banking without touching the screen.
rationale: Banks never control a customer's device remotely; combining an inbound call, a remote-access tool, an open banking app and a loss threat is account-draining fraud.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
